purpose: Batch 1 collector regression bench: fixed reference cases from the Newcastle, Louis Trichardt / Thohoyandou, Polokwane and Musina manual sweeps of 23 Oct 2026. Measuring only; nothing here changes a collector.

field_notes.match: Case-insensitive regex on title + content. A saved signal from the case's own sweep that matches is one record of the case.
field_notes.match_also: Optional second regex that must also match (narrows a broad name).
field_notes.title_only: When true, match and match_also look at the title only (for stories other reports mention in passing).
field_notes.query_match: Optional regex on the Google News query that produced the record.
field_notes.expected_place: Place names the location candidate may carry for the place check to pass (a containing town counts where the suburb is not in the gazetteer).
field_notes.expected_precinct: Police precinct from the sweep note, where the note states one. Collectors do not output precincts yet, so this is recorded but not scored.
field_notes.one_record: True when the case should arrive as a single record.
field_notes.keep_out_rule: For keep_out cases: absent | not_placed_in_province | not_placed_at | not_stream | court_step_flagged | date_is_incident
